# `select.group_delete`: Delete group

Removes a named group; the geometry stays.

- Category: select
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(groups)
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: remove vertex group, delete face map

Removes the group only; the faces, edges or vertices stay in the mesh.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | `string` | required | Group to remove (the geometry stays). |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"group":"bottom","target":"crate"}
```

Result: `crate (o:1): deleted group bottom`
